ing: plus a little for the sauce
you used ½; use 1–2 for more garlic
a chunk, for a glossy, thicker sauce
steps: Pat the salmon dry and rub with the salt, pepper, 1 tsp Cajun, ½ tsp paprika and the oil. Leave while the pasta water heats.
Season salmon
Boil the pasta in well-salted water. Save a mug of pasta water before draining.
Boil pasta
Pan-fry the salmon on medium-high, skin or presentation side down first, until crisp.
First side
Flip and cook until it just flakes. Remove and break into big chunks.
Second side
In the same pan on medium, soften the onion in a little oil.
Soften onion
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the tomato purée, stirring until it darkens.
Purée
Pour in the cream and bubble gently.
Simmer cream
Stir in the truffle cheese until melted, then the butter, paprika and Cajun. The butter makes the sauce glossy and helps it cling. Taste for salt.
Melt cheese
Add the pasta with a splash of pasta water and toss until glossy, adding more water if it's thick.
Toss pasta
Fold the salmon back in gently and give it a good mix. Finish with parsley.
note: Asu's own recipe, first made by eye and measured up afterwards. Cajun seasoning is already salty, so taste before adding more salt. Truffle cream cheese works well for the truffle cheese; Boursin or plain cream cheese with a few drops of truffle oil also work.

n: Shrimp Linguine That Tastes Like Shrimp
steps: Peel the prawns and keep the shells and heads. Fry the shells in the oil until bright red.
Fry shells
Add 250 ml water, simmer, then strain. This is your prawn stock.
Prawn stock
Boil the linguine for a minute less than the packet says. Keep some pasta water.
Boil pasta
Sear the prawns in a knob of butter, about a minute a side. Set aside.
Sear prawns
Soften the shallot and garlic, then stir in the purée and chilli.
Base
Add the wine and let it bubble off, then the prawn stock. Reduce by half.
Reduce
Stir in the cream, add the pasta and toss until it's glossy and coated.
Toss
Off the heat, add the rest of the butter, the prawns, a squeeze of lemon and chives.
note: Rafi's written recipe is on Provecho. This version follows the reel: a quick stock made from the prawn shells is what gives it the deep prawn flavour.

steps: Chop the cabbage and cube the tofu. Mix the minced garlic, honey, soy, pepper and a pinch of salt.
Layer everything in a freezer box: cabbage, sauce, beef, tofu, rice cakes, sprouts, enoki. Freeze overnight.
To cook, microwave the box for 15 seconds to loosen the block.
Put the frozen block in a pot with the broth, cover and boil until everything's cooked through.
Boil hot pot
note: About 450 kcal and 38 g protein per serving. Pack the kits ahead and freeze, then cook one straight from frozen.
mp: Kits keep 2 months in the freezer.

steps: Boil the pasta and keep a mug of pasta water.
Boil pasta
Season the chicken and sear in the oil.
First side
Flip and cook through. Rest, then slice.
Second side
Melt the butter, add the garlic and chopped sun-dried tomatoes.
Garlic
Add the stock and cream and simmer.
Simmer sauce
Stir in the parmesan, then the spinach until wilted.
Spinach
Toss in the pasta with a splash of pasta water and top with the chicken.
note: Jo & Bart's full recipe is in their paid cookbook. This is the classic Tuscan chicken from the reel: sun-dried tomatoes, spinach and a parmesan cream sauce.

steps: Toss the chicken with the seasoning and 1 tbsp oil. Cook in the rest of the oil over medium-high until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
Cook chicken
Sauté the mushrooms in the same pan until browned, with a pinch of salt.
Mushrooms
Add the garlic and butter.
Garlic
Pour in the cream, add salt, pepper and Italian seasoning and simmer gently.
Simmer
Meanwhile cook the fettuccine.
Boil pasta
Stir in the parmesan until smooth, return the chicken, then toss in the pasta.
Boil the pasta in well-salted water. Keep at least half a mug of pasta water.
Boil pasta
Pat the prawns dry and season with salt, pepper and chilli. Soften the onion and garlic in the butter, then add the prawns.
Onion
Sear the prawns until just cooked. Remove.
Prawns
Add the tomato purée and cook, stirring, until it darkens.
Purée
Stir in the cream and 60 ml pasta water and simmer.
Simmer
Add the pasta and parmesan and toss on low until smooth. Return the prawns for 30 seconds and season.
Melt the butter on medium-high. Add the shallot, garlic and chilli flakes until fragrant.
Aromatics
Add the prawns and toss until pink. Season. They don't need to be cooked through yet. Remove.
Prawns
Add the oil and the tomato purée and fry.
Purée
Pour in the cream, then the parmesan and stock.
Return the prawns and simmer on medium-low until they're cooked and the sauce has thickened.
Simmer
Serve over rice.
Cook the pasta and keep a mug of pasta water.
Boil pasta
Brown the mushrooms in the oil over medium-high. Set aside.
Mushrooms
Melt the butter on medium until foaming and golden. Cook the shallots and garlic until soft.
Shallots
Stir in the pepper, miso and soy.
Add the stock and cream and simmer until slightly thick.
Simmer
Add the pasta, mushrooms and milk and toss, loosening with pasta water if needed.
Off the heat, toss in the parmesan. Finish with chives and more pepper.
note: Randy uses 340 g of pasta for 2, which makes big portions. Use chicken or veg stock; veg stock keeps it vegetarian.

steps: Cook the pasta to a minute before al dente and keep the pasta water.
Boil pasta
Pat the scallops completely dry and season. Sear in a hot pan without crowding, about 2 minutes a side, until deep golden. Remove.
Sear scallops
Turn to medium. Cook the shallot and garlic, deglazing with a splash of water.
Shallot
Add the cream and 60 ml water mixed with the hondashi and simmer.
Simmer
Stir in the parmesan and lemon juice and taste.
Toss in the pasta with pasta water, top with the scallops and parsley.
note: Hondashi is Japanese dashi powder. Half a fish or veg stock cube works instead.

steps: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika and 1 tbsp oil.
Marinate
Cook the fettuccine. Keep a mug of pasta water.
Boil pasta
Cook the chicken in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high, turning once. Rest and slice.
Cook chicken
In the same pan, melt the butter, add the chilli crisp, then whisk in the flour.
Roux
Whisk in the cream and seasonings and simmer gently until slightly thick.
Simmer
On low, stir in the parmesan and lemon juice. Toss in the pasta with pasta water, add the chicken and simmer together.
Toss
af: Air-fry the marinated chicken at 200°C for 14–16 minutes, turning halfway, while the sauce cooks.

steps: Soften the diced onion in 1 tbsp oil, then the garlic for 30 seconds.
Onion
Add the beef and brown, breaking it up. Drain off most of the fat.
Brown beef
Add the purée and spices for a minute, then the jalapeño, Worcestershire and 120 ml water. Simmer until the liquid has gone.
Reduce filling
Mix the sauce: mayo, ketchup, mustard, chopped gherkin, pickle juice, a little minced onion, garlic powder, paprika, sugar and pepper.
Spread sauce on each tortilla, add beef, cheese, onions and jalapeños, then fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Fry seam-side down in a thin layer of oil, pressing gently, turning until crisp all over.
Fry wraps
note: Makes 9 wraps. A grated cheddar and mozzarella mix stands in for the Mexican four-cheese blend.
mp: Freeze rolled wraps; pan-fry from defrosted.
af: Brush the wraps with oil and air-fry seam-side down at 190°C for 8 minutes, turning halfway.

steps: Trim the root off the enoki and pull it into small bundles. Wrap each bundle in a slice of beef.
Mix the sauce ingredients with 120 ml water.
Sear the rolls seam-side down over medium-high so they seal.
Seal rolls
Turn to brown all over.
Brown rolls
Pour in the sauce and simmer, turning, until thick and glossy. Serve over rice with spring onion.
Glaze
Season the salmon. Sear skin-side down in the oil.
Skin side
Flip and cook the other side. Remove.
Other side
Melt the butter and fry the garlic.
Garlic
Add the cream and simmer.
Simmer
Stir in the cheese until melted.
Melt cheese
Return the salmon, spoon the sauce over and scatter with parsley.
note: The reel uses a Malaysian nacho cheese sauce. Grated cheddar melted into cream does the same job, or use 4 tbsp of any nacho cheese sauce.

steps: Brown the mince with the diced onion in the oil.
Brown mince
Add the garlic and purée and fry.
Garlic & purée
Add the tomatoes, stock, Italian seasoning and chilli and simmer.
Simmer broth
Add the broken lasagne sheets and cook, stirring, until tender.
Cook pasta
Mix the ricotta, mozzarella and parmesan. Ladle the soup into bowls and top with a spoonful plus basil.
note: The recipe is only sent by DM, so this is the classic lasagne soup from the reel: broken lasagne sheets in a tomato broth, topped with a ricotta and mozzarella dollop.
mp: Store the soup and cheese topping separately; the pasta softens over time.

steps: Warm the refried beans on low, thinning with water and seasoning with salt, pepper and half the spices.
Warm beans
Brown the mince and drain. Add the purée, the rest of the spices and a splash of water.
Brown beef
Simmer the beef a little longer.
Simmer
Warm the tortillas so they bend. Add beans, beef and cheese, fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Eat straight away, or wrap individually and freeze.
note: Makes about 12. Wrap each in foil or cling film and freeze. Reheat in the microwave, a frying pan or the air fryer.
mp: Freeze individually wrapped; microwave 2–3 minutes or air-fry.

steps: Cut the mozzarella into sticks about 1–2 cm thick. Dust lightly in flour.
Freeze the sticks until solid.
Freeze sticks
Beat the eggs. Dip each frozen stick in egg, then breadcrumbs, then egg and breadcrumbs again. This double coat stops leaks.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 175°C. If you have no thermometer, a breadcrumb should sizzle straight away.
Fry straight from frozen in small batches until golden and floating, 2–3 minutes. Don't crowd the pan.
Fry batch
While they fry, ladle about 120 ml of the hot frying oil into a heatproof bowl and stir in the cayenne, paprika, garlic powder and brown sugar.
Brush or toss the sticks in the hot oil while they're still steaming. Serve straight away with ranch.
af: After the double coat, freeze again, then spray well with oil. Air-fry at 200°C for 6–7 minutes, turning halfway. Pull them the moment one starts to ooze. Heat the 120 ml of oil for the hot oil in a small pan.

steps: Cut the pork into strips about 4 cm thick and 15 cm long. Sprinkle the salt over every side.
Grate the garlic and ginger. Whisk them with the soy, hoisin, Shaoxing wine, honey, five spice and food colouring. Set 3 tbsp aside in the fridge for basting.
Coat the pork in the rest of the marinade, cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours, or overnight.
Marinate
Air fryer: heat to 200°C and oil the basket. Lay the pork in one layer. Oven instead: 200°C (180°C fan) on a rack over a foil-lined tray.
Cook, then flip and baste with the reserved marinade.
First side
Cook again, then flip and baste a second time.
Second side
Finish until sticky and charred at the edges. In the oven, allow 30–35 minutes in total and grill for the last 3.
Finish
Rest before slicing into 1 cm pieces. Serve with rice and greens.
Rest pork
mp: Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen. Slice cold, then warm in a pan with a splash of water.

ing: Spice mix (or 4 tbsp ready-made butter chicken masala)
steps: Heat the ghee or butter in a wide pan. Sauté the chicken until it's no longer pink on the outside.
Seal chicken
Add the spice mix, salt and chilli powder. Stir and cook until fragrant.
Toast spices
Stir in the tomato purée and cook until it no longer smells raw.
Cook purée
Pour in about three-quarters of the cream and bring to a rolling boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low and simmer until the chicken is tender.
Simmer
Loosen with the rest of the cream. Finish with a squeeze of lemon and chopped coriander.
mp: Keeps 4 days in the fridge and freezes for 3 months. Freeze the curry without rice.

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line a tray.
Score a criss-cross into the top of the brie. Drizzle with honey and scatter over the chilli, garlic and herbs.
Slice the baguette, brush with olive oil and arrange around the brie.
Bake until the brie is soft and melty and the bread is toasted.
Bake brie
Serve hot with fig jam.
Mix the prawns with the buttermilk, salt and white pepper. Chill.
Marinate prawns
Whisk the mayo, sweet chilli sauce and sriracha. Keep in the fridge.
Heat the oil to 190°C. Drain the prawns and toss them in cornflour.
Fry in batches until golden.
Fry batch
Drain, toss the hot prawns in the sauce and serve over shredded lettuce with sliced spring onion.
note: The reel is a Bonefish Grill copycat with no written recipe. This is Taste of Home's copycat version of the same dish.
af: Spray the cornflour-coated prawns well with oil. Air-fry in one layer at 200°C for 8–10 minutes, shaking halfway, then toss in the sauce.

n: Tomato & Mince Pasta with Melted Cheese
steps: Put the oil in a pot. Cut the tops off the tomatoes and set them cut-side down on the base. Chop the onion and put it in the middle.
Cook on medium, lid on, until the tomatoes are completely soft. Meanwhile boil the pasta in salted water.
Soften tomatoes
Push the tomatoes aside, add the mince to the middle and fry until browned.
Brown mince
Pull off the tomato skins and mash the tomatoes with a fork. Let it bubble.
Simmer sauce
Stir in the purée, crushed garlic, chopped parsley, salt, pepper and plenty of cheese.
Add the drained pasta and stir until everything's coated and stringy.
note: Translated from Turkish (Pratik Makarna). Kaşar cheese is swapped for mild cheddar or mozzarella.
mp: Keeps 3 days. Add a splash of water when reheating.

n: Spicy Short Rib Coconut Curry Rice Bowls
steps: Salt the short ribs. Brown them well in the oil, in batches, on sauté mode or in a heavy pot. Set aside.
Brown ribs
Fry the curry paste in the fat, scraping up the browned bits.
Fry curry paste
Add the halved shallots, smashed garlic, ginger coins, soy, fish sauce, sugar and stock. Return the ribs.
Seal and pressure cook on high.
Pressure cook
Let the pressure release naturally, then quick-release the rest. Cook the rice now.
Natural release
Lift out the ribs and shred the meat off the bones.
Strain the broth, discard the aromatics, stir in the coconut milk and taste for salt and sugar.
Bowl up rice and shredded beef, pour the hot broth over and top with basil, spring onion, sesame and chilli oil.
note: No pressure cooker? Braise covered at 160°C (140°C fan) for about 3 hours instead.
mp: Store beef and broth separately from the rice; the broth freezes well.

steps: Mash the warm rice with a wet pestle or the end of a rolling pin. Microwave cold rice first.
Wet your hands, shape three balls and flatten them into patties.
Pan-fry in sesame oil over medium heat until golden underneath.
First side
Flip and brown the other side.
Second side
Add the soy sauce, let it sizzle for a few seconds and take off the heat.
Wrap each patty with a strip of nori and serve.
Toast the dried chillies in a dry pan for 10–20 seconds a side, then cover with hot water.
Soak chillies
Blend the chillies with the garlic, onion, tomato, spices, vinegar, salt and half a mug of soaking water. Strain.
Simmer the chicken in the adobo with half a mug of water, covered, until it shreds easily.
Simmer chicken
Shred the chicken and cook it down in the sauce until thick and fairly dry.
Reduce filling
Warm the tortillas so they bend. Fill, roll tightly and pin with a cocktail stick.
Shallow-fry in 1 cm of oil at about 180°C, turning once, until crisp.
Fry tacos
Salsa: boil the tomatoes, chillies, onion and garlic, blend with salt, then fry in a teaspoon of oil.
Boil salsa
Top the tacos with lettuce, soured cream, crumbled cheese, salsa and avocado.
note: The reel has no written recipe. This is a standard tacos dorados method with a guajillo adobo. Check the reel for her salsa.
af: Brush the rolled tacos with oil and air-fry seam-side down at 200°C for 8–10 minutes, turning halfway.

steps: Boil the noodles until soft, then drain.
Boil noodles
Heat the sesame oil in a pan over medium. Add the spring onion greens and ginger and cook until slightly charred.
Char aromatics
Add the prawns and cook until pink.
Cook prawns
Add the dark soy, kecap manis and ramen seasoning.
Toss in the noodles, mix well and top with more chopped spring onion.
Mix the chicken with the yogurt and marinade spices. Leave for at least 30 minutes, ideally overnight.
Marinate
Spread the chicken on a tray and grill or roast at 210°C.
Grill chicken
Meanwhile fry the diced onions until golden brown.
Fry onions
Add the chopped tomatoes and three-quarters of the tin in water. Stir in the sauce spices and cook on low.
Simmer sauce
Let the sauce cool a little, then blend until smooth.
Return the sauce to the pan with the chicken. Stir in the cream and butter and simmer on low.
Finish curry
Naan: melt the butter with the chopped garlic and fenugreek. Brush it over the naan and warm in the oven.
Warm naan
Finish the curry with fresh coriander.
note: Chadli costs this at about £2.80 a portion.
mp: Freeze the curry in portions; warm naan fresh.

steps: Heat a frying pan over medium and lightly cook the beef.
Cook beef
Pile the cooked rice in the middle of the pan.
Put the corn and spring onions on top and drizzle the BBQ sauce around the edge.
Add the butter and lots of black pepper. Mix well, then leave it to crisp on the bottom.
Crisp rice
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Line a tray with baking paper.
In a small pan on medium-low, combine the honey, chilli flakes, soy, 45 g butter, lemon juice and 80 ml water.
Simmer glaze
Mix the cornflour with a tablespoon of water. Stir it in off the heat, then simmer again until thick.
Thicken glaze
Stir in the last of the butter and let the sauce cool.
Season the salmon, brush with oil and bake.
Bake salmon
Spoon 1–2 tbsp glaze over each fillet and bake again.
Glaze & bake
Serve over rice with extra sauce.
af: Air-fry the oiled salmon at 200°C for 8 minutes, brush with glaze, then 2 minutes more.

steps: Pat the wings very dry. Toss with the salt, pepper, garlic powder and paprika and leave to sit.
Season wings
Whisk the flour, cornflour, lemon pepper, garlic powder and a pinch of salt. Press each wing into it firmly and shake off the excess.
Heat the oil to 175°C. Fry in batches until deep golden and rigid.
Fry wings
Drain on a rack. Melt the butter on low and whisk in the lemon juice, zest, lemon pepper and garlic powder.
Bloom butter
Toss the hot wings in the butter in a big bowl until glossy. Serve with lemon wedges.
af: Skip the flour coat. Toss the dried wings with the spices plus 1 tsp baking powder and air-fry at 200°C for 22–25 minutes, turning halfway, then toss in the lemon pepper butter.

steps: Heat the oil and butter in a large frying pan over medium-high until foaming.
Add the halved mushrooms in a single layer. Cook, stirring now and then, until browned and the liquid has gone.
Brown mushrooms
Turn the heat down. Add the garlic, thyme, salt and pepper.
Garlic
Splash in the wine if using and let it cook off. Serve hot.
note: The reel's caption has no recipe. This is a steakhouse-style garlic butter mushroom method.

steps: Pat the chicken dry and season with salt. Brown it in the oil over medium-high. It doesn't need to cook through. Set aside.
Sear chicken
Lower to medium. Cook the sliced onion, then add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Soften onion
Add the curry paste and stir constantly.
Fry paste
Stir in a third of the coconut milk and let it bubble, then add the rest with the stock.
Split coconut
Stir in the fish sauce and sugar. Add the chicken, its juices and the sliced pepper. Simmer uncovered.
Simmer curry
Off the heat, add lime juice to taste. Serve over rice with basil and spring onion.
mp: Keeps 4 days in the fridge; freeze without the rice.

n: Braised Beef Cheeks in Red Wine & Stout
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Season the cheeks and dust with flour.
Brown hard in the oil in a casserole, about 3 minutes a side. Remove.
Brown cheeks
Soften the diced onion, carrot and celery.
Soften veg
Add the garlic for a minute, then the tomato purée for 2 minutes.
Garlic & purée
Pour in the wine and reduce by half.
Reduce wine
Add the stout, stock, Worcestershire and herbs and bring to a simmer. Return the cheeks. The liquid should almost cover them.
Cover with baking paper and the lid and braise until fork-tender.
Braise
Lift out the cheeks. Strain the liquid and boil it down to a glossy jus.
Reduce jus
Whisk in the butter, season and serve over mash.
note: Jack's own recipe is behind his paid recipe platform. This is a matching red wine and stout braise.
mp: Even better the next day. Freezes for 3 months in its jus.

steps: Rub the chicken all over with the spices, salt and pepper.
Cook skin-side down in the oil over medium-high until golden.
Skin side
Flip and cook through.
Other side
Rest the chicken. In the fat left behind, fry the chopped onion and garlic.
Onion & garlic
Add the coconut milk and curry cubes and stir until smooth. Simmer until slightly thick.
Simmer sauce
Slice the chicken and serve over rice with the sauce and spring onion.
mp: Keeps 3 days. Slice the chicken before boxing.

steps: Let the chicken come to room temperature. Trim any excess fat or skin.
Dust with flour and tap off the excess.
Sear skin-side down in a little oil over medium heat.
Skin side
Flip and cook the meat side until about 80% done.
Meat side
Add the sugar, soy and wine. Simmer, spooning the sauce over, until it turns thick and glossy.
Glaze
Take the chicken out, slice and serve.
note: Uses dry, low-acid white wine and sugar in place of sake and mirin. Pinot Grigio or Pinot Gris is ideal; avoid fruity wines.
mp: Make 4 portions at once; see Teriyaki Chicken Meal-Prep Bowls.
af: Air-fry the floured thighs skin-up at 200°C for 14–16 minutes, then glaze in a pan with the sauce for 1–2 minutes.

steps: Cut the salmon into large bite-size pieces, season with salt and pepper and rest.
Rest salmon
Pat off the moisture and coat with flour. Mix the sesame seeds, wine, soy and sugar.
Sear in an oiled pan over medium until browned on both sides.
Sear salmon
Wipe out excess oil, add the sauce and simmer, turning, until coated.
Glaze
note: Traditional option: swap the wine for 1 tbsp sake + 1 tbsp mirin and use ½ tbsp sugar.

steps: Spread the Nutella into an 18 cm circle on cling film, cover and freeze until firm.
Freeze Nutella
Brown the butter in a pan until golden and nutty. Stir in the cream, then let it cool a little.
Brown butter
Stir in both sugars, vanilla, salt and coffee. Mix in the egg and yolk only until combined.
Add the flour, cornflour, bicarb and baking powder and mix to a dough. Fold in 150 g chocolate chips.

Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan). Press three-quarters of the dough into the tin with a small rim. Lay the frozen Nutella disc on top, cover with the rest of the dough and scatter over the last chocolate chips.
Bake until golden.
Bake pie
Cool for at least an hour before cutting so it sets.
Cool pie
note: Translated from German. You need a 20 cm springform tin.

steps: Pull off the side muscle. Dry the scallops uncovered in the fridge for at least an hour. Take out 15 minutes before cooking and salt lightly.
Dry scallops
Heat a stainless pan on medium-low for 4 minutes, then medium-high for 2.
Heat pan
Add oil and sear the scallops on one side only, until deep golden. Remove.
Sear scallops
On medium, cook the diced shallot and onion with the vinegar.
Shallots
Add the butter, sprinkle in the flour and stir.
Roux
Add the wine, thyme and any scallop juices. Reduce by a third.
Reduce wine
Add the cream, nutmeg, white pepper and a pinch of salt and simmer.
Simmer cream
Stir in the honey and 85 g of the cheese until melted.
Melt cheese
Heat the grill. Half-fill the shells with sauce, top with half the remaining cheese and grill until bubbling.
Grill once
Add 3 scallops per shell, cover with the rest of the cheese and grill until golden.
Grill twice
Finish with chives and lemon.
note: Makes 6 shells, 2 per person as a main or 1 each as a starter. Use scallop shells or small ovenproof dishes.

steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente. Save half a mug of pasta water before draining.
Boil pasta
Pat the prawns dry and toss with 1 tbsp oil, the salt, pepper and smoked paprika.
Sear the prawns in a hot pan until opaque. Set aside.
Sear prawns
Turn to medium-low. Add the rest of the oil and the butter, then the garlic. Don't let it burn.
Garlic
Pour in the stock and scrape up the bits. Add the cream and simmer until slightly thick.
Simmer sauce
Melt in a handful of parmesan and a squeeze of lemon.
Toss in the pasta with splashes of pasta water. Return the prawns and toss.
Toss
Stir in the parsley. Taste before adding salt, since the pasta water is already salty.
Put the oil and thinly sliced garlic in a pan over low heat to infuse until lightly golden.
Infuse garlic
Add the prawns and cook until pink, turning once.
Cook prawns
Add the paprika, lemon juice and chilli, then salt and lots of parsley.
Serve at once with warm bread for the oil.
Soak the vermicelli in warm water. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces.
Soak noodles
Bring 350 ml water with the sake, mirin and soy to a boil. Add the chicken, skim and simmer.
Simmer chicken
Add the cabbage stems, then after a few minutes the leaves, tofu and enoki.
Veg in
Add the drained vermicelli until it turns clear.
Noodles
Off the boil, dissolve the miso in a ladle of broth and stir it back in. Don't boil it again.
Add the rice vinegar and top with spring onion.
note: The caption lists ingredients only, so the method and water amount are a standard miso chicken nabe.

steps: Steam or boil the potatoes until fork-tender.
Cook potatoes
Mash while hot. Add the potato starch and salt and knead to a smooth dough, adding a splash of water if dry.
Roll into small boba-size balls.
Boil until they float, then move to cold water and drain.
Boil boba
Put the boba in a bowl with the gochugaru, spring onion, garlic and soy.
Heat the oil until shimmering, pour it over and mix.
af: Steam the potatoes in the air fryer basket wrapped in foil at 200°C for 25 minutes instead of boiling.

steps: Cook the condensed milk, coconut, butter and salt on low, stirring, until thick and pulling away from the sides.
Cook mixture
Cool completely in the fridge.
Chill mixture
Roll into small balls and chill until firm.
Chill balls
Cook the sugar and water without stirring until it's an amber caramel.
Caramel
Dip each ball, let the excess drip off and set on baking paper.
Fry the chopped garlic in the butter until fragrant and just golden.
Fry garlic
Add the chopped parsley and fry briefly.
Parsley
Stir in the seasonings and the washed rice to coat.
Rice cooker: add 360 ml water and cook as normal. On the hob: add the water, bring to a boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat.
Cook rice
Rest with the lid on, then fluff.
Rest rice
note: Translated from Indonesian. Great with grilled chicken or steak.
mp: Cool quickly and refrigerate within an hour; reheat only once, until steaming hot.

ing: room temp, plus extra for the tin
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Butter a small 15 cm tin or muffin tin generously.
Whisk the milk, melted butter, egg and vanilla. Add the flour, sugar and salt and whisk smooth. Sieve for a silkier result.
Pour into the tin and bake until deep golden and crisp on top. Muffin tins need about 35 minutes.
Bake mochi
Cool on a rack for a few minutes and eat warm.
Cool
note: Ingredients are Helen's. She didn't post a method, so the bake is based on the viral Korean butter tteok. Dip in condensed milk.

steps: Boil the fettuccine in salted water until al dente. Save half a mug of pasta water.
Boil pasta
Pat the salmon dry and coat with the seasoning, paprika, salt and pepper.
Sear in the oil and a knob of butter over medium-high, turning once. Remove and flake.
Sear salmon
In the same pan on medium, soften the shallot in the rest of the butter, then add the garlic.
Shallot & garlic
Add the cream and a little more seasoning and simmer.
Simmer cream
Off the high heat, stir in the parmesan, lemon zest and juice.
Toss in the pasta, loosen with pasta water and top with salmon, parsley and chilli flakes.
note: The caption lists ingredients without amounts. Quantities and method are filled in to match.

steps: Take the steaks out of the fridge 30 minutes before. Mix all the butter ingredients in a bowl.
Temper steaks
Season the steaks well. Sear in the oil over medium-high.
First side
Flip and sear the second side.
Second side
Turn to medium, add half the butter and baste as it foams.
Baste
Rest, then slice and spoon over more butter.
Rest steak
note: The caption gives the butter. The steak method comes from Alf's own steak-and-butter posts. Pull at 52–54°C for medium-rare.

steps: Break up the cold rice with your fingers so there are no clumps.
Scramble the beaten eggs in hot oil until just set, then push to one side.
Eggs
Add the rice and peas and fry on high, tossing, until the rice is hot and starts to pop.
Fry rice
Season with soy, white pepper and salt, mix the egg through, then add the sesame oil and spring onion.
Season
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt. Scramble in 1 tbsp oil until barely set and remove.
Eggs
Fry the tomato wedges in the rest of the oil, pressing, until saucy.
Tomatoes
Add the ketchup, sugar, salt and 3 tbsp water and bubble.
Sauce
Return the eggs, fold through and top with spring onion. Serve over rice.
Toss the chicken with soy and cornflour. Mix the sauce with 3 tbsp water.
Marinate
Fry the chicken in hot oil until golden and cooked. Remove.
Fry chicken
Fry the chillies and peppercorns for a few seconds, then the garlic, ginger and spring onion whites.
Aromatics
Return the chicken, pour in the sauce and toss until glossy. Stir in the peanuts and spring onion greens.
Toss

Fry the mince until crisp, then the doubanjiang, garlic and ginger until the oil turns red.

Thicken with the cornflour mixed with water in 2–3 additions, nudging rather than stirring.
Thicken
Top with ground Sichuan pepper and spring onion. Serve with rice.

steps: Toss the beef with soy, cornflour and a splash of oil.
Marinate
Sear the beef in a smoking-hot wok in two batches. Remove.
Sear beef
Stir-fry the onion and peppers until just softened, adding the garlic at the end.
Veg
Return the beef with the sauce and 2 tbsp water and toss until glossy.
Toss

Steam salmon
Pour off the liquid. Warm the soy with the sugar and 2 tbsp water and spoon it round the fish. Pile on the rest of the ginger and the spring onion.
Heat the oil until smoking and pour it over the ginger and spring onion so they sizzle. Serve with rice.
note: No steamer? Wrap the fish in foil and bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 12 minutes.

steps: Fry the garlic in the oil until just golden.
Garlic
Add the greens and a splash of water, toss on high heat.
Greens
Add the oyster sauce and a pinch of salt and toss.
Dip the chicken in beaten egg, then toss in cornflour.
Coat chicken
Shallow-fry in batches until golden and crisp. Drain.
Fry chicken
Stir-fry the onion and peppers for a couple of minutes.
Veg
Add the sauce with 4 tbsp pineapple juice and bubble until glossy, then toss in the pineapple and chicken.
Sauce
af: Spray the coated chicken with oil and air-fry at 200°C for 12–14 minutes, shaking halfway, then toss in the sauce.

steps: Soften the sliced onion, add the diced carrot and potato and 600 ml water. Simmer until tender.
Simmer veg
Turn off the heat, stir in the curry roux until dissolved, then simmer until thick.
Thicken curry
Meanwhile bash the chicken thin. Coat in flour, egg, then panko.
Shallow-fry until golden and cooked through, turning once.
Fry katsu
Slice and serve over rice with the curry poured alongside.
note: S&B Golden Curry is stocked in both supermarkets. The sauce freezes well; fry the katsu fresh, or reheat it in the oven to keep it crisp.
mp: Keeps 3–4 days in sealed boxes in the fridge. Reheat until piping hot.
af: Toss the panko in 1 tbsp oil first so it browns, then crumb the chicken. Air-fry at 200°C for 12–15 minutes, turning halfway.

steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the mince with the sliced onion until crisp at the edges.
Brown beef
Add the garlic, ginger, soy, sugar and gochujang and cook until sticky.
Glaze
Stir in the sesame oil. Box up with rice, grated carrot, cucumber and spring onion; top with sesame. Fry an egg on top when you eat it.
mp: Keeps 3–4 days in sealed boxes in the fridge. Reheat until piping hot.

steps: Brown the seasoned chicken in a large lidded pan. Remove.
Brown chicken
Fry the sliced chorizo until it releases its red oil, then the onion and pepper.
Chorizo & veg
Stir in the garlic, paprika and rice, then the tomatoes and stock. Return the chicken.
Cover and simmer on low without stirring.
Simmer rice
Scatter in the peas, cover and rest off the heat. Finish with lemon and parsley.
Rest
mp: Keeps 3–4 days in sealed boxes in the fridge. Reheat until piping hot.

steps: Cook the rice. Steam or boil the broccoli florets and sliced carrots.
Veg
Dust the chicken in flour and fry skin-side down until golden, in two batches if needed.
Brown chicken
Flip and cook through.
Cook through
Add the soy, sugar and wine and reduce until thick and glossy, turning the chicken.
Glaze
Slice and pack into 4 boxes with rice, veg, sauce and sesame.
note: A 4-box batch version of the teriyaki chicken, using the same wine-and-sugar sauce trick.
mp: Keeps 3–4 days in sealed boxes in the fridge. Reheat until piping hot.
af: Air-fry the floured thighs skin-up at 200°C for 16–18 minutes, then reduce the sauce in a pan and toss.

ing: Thai if you can find it
steps: Pound or finely chop the garlic and chilli. Fry in oil for 20 seconds.
Add the chicken and stir-fry on high until cooked and slightly crisp.
Fry chicken
Add the sauces, sugar and a splash of water, then toss in the basil until wilted.
Basil
Serve over rice with a crispy fried egg.
Fry the mince until crisp and brown, then add both soys.
Crisp pork
Whisk the sauce in two bowls with a splash of hot noodle water.
Cook the noodles and pak choi together.
Noodles
Divide into the bowls, top with the pork, peanuts and spring onion and mix well.

steps: Soften the finely chopped onion, carrot and celery in the oil.
Soffritto
Turn up the heat and brown the mince well, then add the garlic and purée.

Add the wine and bubble off, then the tomatoes, stock, herbs and milk.
Wine
Simmer gently with the lid ajar, stirring now and then, until rich and thick.

Cook only the pasta you need. Freeze the rest of the sauce in portions.

steps: Boil the pasta and keep a mug of pasta water.

Soften the onion and garlic in the butter.

Fry the gochujang and purée until darker.
Paste
Add the cream and a splash of pasta water and simmer.

Toss in the pasta and parmesan, loosen as needed and top with spring onion.

Warm the garlic and chilli in the oil on low until pale gold.
Garlic oil
Add the prawns and cook until pink.
Prawns
Toss in the pasta with a good splash of pasta water until it turns silky. Finish with lemon zest, juice and parsley.

Fry the diced chicken until cooked.
Chicken

Bake
mp: Keeps 3–4 days in sealed boxes in the fridge. Reheat until piping hot.

steps: Cook the rice and steam the broccoli.
Rice & broccoli

Fry chicken
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the honey, soy and vinegar. Bubble until sticky.
Glaze
Pack into 4 boxes with rice and broccoli and sprinkle with sesame.
mp: Keeps 3–4 days in sealed boxes in the fridge. Reheat until piping hot.
af: Air-fry the cornflour-coated thighs at 200°C for 15–18 minutes, then toss in the sauce bubbled in a pan.

steps: Score both sides of each wing twice. Put them in a pan of cold water with a few ginger slices and the Shaoxing wine, bring to the boil and blanch.
Blanch wings
Drain and pat completely dry.
Fry the wings in the oil over medium heat until golden on both sides.
Brown wings
Add the rest of the ginger and the spring onion, then the soy and dark soy. Pour in cola to just cover.
Cover and simmer.
Simmer
Uncover, turn up the heat and reduce, turning the wings, until the sauce is thick and sticky.
Reduce glaze
Scatter with sesame seeds.

af: For less mess, air-fry the blanched, dried wings at 200°C for 12 minutes, then simmer them in the cola sauce to glaze.

ing: mixed with half a small bowl of water
steps: Fry the thighs skin-side down in a dry pan until golden and the fat renders.
Skin side
Flip and brown the other side. Add the potato chunks if using.
Flip
Add the soy, dark soy, Shaoxing wine, oyster sauce and a pinch of white pepper, then pour in the cola.
Simmer slowly.
Simmer
Stir in the cornflour water and bubble until glossy and thick.

Slice the chicken and spoon it with the sauce over rice. Top with spring onion.

mp: Keeps 3 days; the sauce thickens, so add water when reheating.

steps: Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp soy, the cornflour and some pepper. Leave while you mix the sauce with 60 ml water.

Fry the chicken in a little oil until golden and cooked through.
Fry chicken
Add the sliced onion and soften.
Onion
Pour in the sauce and let it bubble until glossy.
Sauce

Set eggs
Slide onto rice and top with spring onion.

steps: Mix the sauce with 80 ml water.
Soften the sliced onion in a little oil.
Onion
Pour in the sauce and let it bubble, then add the beef and stir until just cooked.
Beef
Push the beef to one side, pour the beaten eggs into the gap, cover and cook on low until just set.
Eggs
Slide it all over rice. Top with spring onion and sesame.

Prawns
Add the beef and stir until it changes colour.
Beef
Pour in the sauce and bubble until thick and glossy.

steps: Blitz the prawns with the cornflour and a pinch of salt to a sticky paste.

Add 600 ml water, the soy and sugar and bring to the boil.

Add the noodles, enoki and pak choi.

steps: Blitz the prawns with 1 tsp cornflour, salt and pepper to a paste.

Serve over rice with spring onion and sesame.

steps: Bone the wing flats, keeping the skin whole. Marinate in the soy, Shaoxing wine and a couple of ginger slices.
Marinate
Chop then blitz the prawns with the cornflour, salt, white pepper and sesame oil. Stir hard in one direction until sticky and bouncy.

Pan-fry in the oil over medium heat until golden on both sides.
Brown wings
Add the ginger, spring onion and star anise, then the Shaoxing wine, both soys and oyster sauce. Pour in the cola to come halfway up the wings.

Uncover, turn the heat up and reduce, spooning the sauce over, until thick, sticky and glossy.

To bone the flats, cut round the top of both bones at the thick end, then twist and pull them out without tearing the skin.

steps: Cut the nori into squares. Dice the salmon, avocado and mango.

steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Soften the onion.

steps: Rinse the rice. Simmer it with the peeled, cubed squash in 1 litre of water, stirring now and then.

steps: Rub the crackle ingredients together, roll 2 mm thick between baking paper and freeze.
Freeze crackle
Bring 60 ml water, the milk, butter, sugar and a pinch of salt to the boil. Tip in the flour and stir over the heat until a film forms.
Cook dough
Cool a little, then beat in the eggs one at a time until the dough falls in a thick V from the spoon.
Cool dough
Pipe 10 mounds and top each with a crackle disc. Bake at 190°C (170°C fan) without opening the door.
Bake hot
Turn down to 170°C (150°C fan) and bake until deep golden and light.
Bake low
Cool, then fill with the cream whipped with the icing sugar.
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.

steps: Rinse the osmanthus. Simmer the rock sugar in 200 ml water until dissolved.
Syrup
Add the osmanthus and lemon juice and simmer until syrupy.
Simmer
Cool until warm, stir in the honey and jar it. Stir into drinks, yoghurt or rice cakes.
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.

steps: Finely chop the spring onions and garlic. Mix with the sesame oil, salt, lemon juice and pepper, then leave to mellow.
Scallion sauce
Season the steaks and sear in a very hot pan.
First side
Flip and sear the other side.
Second side
Rest, then slice.
Rest steak
Fan over rice and spoon the scallion sauce on top.
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.
mp: Slice steak cold for lunch boxes; eat within 2 days.

steps: Put the garlic in cold oil and heat gently until pale gold. Scoop out the chips and keep the oil.
Garlic chips
Sear the seasoned steaks in the garlic oil.
First side
Flip, add the butter and baste.
Second side
Rest the steaks. Add the soy and mirin to the pan and bubble for 30 seconds.
Rest steak
Slice over rice, pour over the pan sauce and scatter with garlic chips.
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.

steps: Mix the chicken with the gochujang, gochugaru, soy, sugar, honey and garlic. Soak the rice cakes in warm water.
Marinate
Fry the chicken until browned.
Fry chicken
Add the onion, cabbage, drained rice cakes and 100 ml water. Simmer, stirring, until the rice cakes are soft.
Simmer
Top with cheese and cover until melted, if using.
Melt cheese
Serve over rice.
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.
mp: Rice cakes firm up in the fridge; reheat with a splash of water.

zh: 红薯卷边咸蛋黄嫩鸡披萨
steps: Steam the peeled sweet potato until soft, then mash.
Steam potato
Pan-fry the seasoned diced chicken.
Chicken
Steam the salted yolks, then mash with the butter.
Salted yolks
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Roll out the dough, lay the sweet potato mash round the edge and fold the dough over it to stuff the crust.
Spread sauce, then cheese, chicken and salted-yolk butter. Bake.
Bake pizza
Zig-zag with mayo and serve.
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.

steps: Whisk the eggs and sugar until thick and pale, fold in the flour and cocoa, then the melted butter. Bake in a 15 cm tin at 170°C (150°C fan).
Bake sponge
Soak the gelatine in cold water.
Bloom gelatine
Warm the milk and cream. Whisk into the yolks and sugar, then stir over low heat until it coats a spoon.
Custard
Stir in the squeezed gelatine. Put the sponge in a cake ring, pour the custard over and chill.
Set custard
Sprinkle with demerara and blowtorch until glassy. Ring with strawberries.
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.

steps: Wash the strawberries and dry them completely, or the chocolate won't stick.
Melt the dark chocolate with the coconut oil in 30-second bursts.
Melt chocolate
Dip, let the excess drip and set on baking paper. Chill.
Set
Drizzle with melted white chocolate.
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.

steps: Heat the milk to steaming, about 85°C, then cool it to about 43°C, warm to a clean finger.
Heat & cool
Whisk in the yoghurt and sugar, then pour into clean jars.
Keep warm and undisturbed until set.
Ferment
Chill before eating.
Chill
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish. Vicky uses a yoghurt maker. Any warm spot at around 40°C works, such as an oven with just the light on.

steps: Heat the milk and cream in a wide pan until steaming, then leave to cool so a thick skin forms. Chill.
Form skin
Lift off the milk skin and cut it into strips. Wrap pieces of fruit and thread onto skewers.
Boil the sugar with 150 ml water without stirring until it hits hard crack, 150°C. A drip should snap in cold water.
Sugar
Twirl each skewer quickly through the syrup and stand on baking paper until glassy.
Set
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.

steps: Boil the sago, stirring, then cover and leave off the heat until clear. Rinse in cold water.
Cook sago
Soak the gelatine.
Bloom gelatine
Warm the milk, coconut milk and sugar and dissolve the squeezed gelatine. Blend in one mango.
Stir in the sago, diced second mango and pomelo. Pour into a lined tray and chill until set.
Chill
Cut into squares.
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.

steps: Stir the hazelnuts in a pan with the sugar until they're coated in amber caramel. Spread out to cool.
Caramel nuts
Melt each chocolate separately. Mix the matcha into one batch of white chocolate.
Spread each onto a lined tray about 5 mm thick and scatter with its topping and a little salt.
Chill until hard, then snap into shards.
Chill
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.

steps: Dust the cut sides of the crab in cornflour and shallow-fry until red and sealed.
Fry crab
In a little oil, fry the ginger, garlic, chillies, peppercorns, doubanjiang and hot pot base until red and fragrant.
Aromatics
Add the crab and celery and toss hard.
Toss
Add the wine, sugar and a splash of water. Cover and cook.
Cover & cook
Toss with spring onion and serve.
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish. Brown crab is the easiest UK crab to buy fresh. Asian grocers sell frozen swimmer crab too.

steps: Bash the chops thin and marinate with the soy, pepper and 1 tbsp cornflour.
Marinate
Stir-fry the rice with 2 beaten eggs and salt until fluffy. Spread in an ovenproof dish.
Egg fried rice
Dip the chops in the last egg, then panko, and shallow-fry until golden.
Fry chops
Soften the onion, add the chopped tomatoes, ketchup, sugar, Worcestershire and a splash of water and simmer.
Tomato sauce
Lay the sliced chops on the rice, pour the sauce over, top with cheese and bake at 220°C (200°C fan).
Bake
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.
af: Spray the breaded chops with oil and air-fry at 200°C for 10–12 minutes, turning halfway.

steps: Simmer the soys, wine, rock sugar, 300 ml water and aromatics until the sugar dissolves.
Make sauce
Add the chicken skin-side down, cover and simmer.
Simmer
Turn the chicken and simmer again, basting.
Turn & baste
Turn off the heat and leave covered to steep.
Steep
Chop and serve with rice and a spoonful of the sauce.
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.
mp: Keeps 3 days; serve cold or warm.

steps: Slice the beef thin and toss with 1 tsp soy, the cornflour and a little oil.
Marinate
Pull the noodles apart. Sear the beef in a smoking-hot wok, then remove.
Sear beef
Fry the onion, then add the noodles and sauce and toss on high heat without breaking them up.
Noodles
Add the sprouts, spring onion and beef and toss.
Finish
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.

steps: Cut a lid off each papaya and scoop out the seeds. Soak the gelatine.
Prep
Warm the milk, cream and sugar and dissolve the squeezed gelatine. Cool until barely warm.
Fill the papayas and chill until set.
Chill
Cut into wedges.
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.

steps: Separate the eggs. Whisk the yolks with the milk and oil, then sift in the flour and cocoa. Whip the whites with the sugar to stiff peaks and fold in. Bake at 160°C (140°C fan).
Bake sponge
Cool completely.
Cool
Whip the cream, mascarpone and icing sugar to soft peaks, then fold in the crushed Oreos.
Oreo cream
Split the sponge, fill and cover with the cream, and top with whole Oreos. Chill.
Chill
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.

steps: Whisk the egg whites and icing sugar, then the flour, vanilla and melted butter.
Spread very thin circles on a lined tray and bake at 160°C (140°C fan) until golden at the edges.
Bake
Cool on a rack, where they turn crisp.
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.

steps: Boil the pasta and save a mug of pasta water.
Boil pasta
Soften the shallot and garlic in the butter.
Shallot
Fry the purée, chilli crisp and flakes until brick red.
Chilli
Add the cream and a splash of pasta water and simmer.
Cream
Toss in the pasta and parmesan until glossy.
Toss
note: From Vicky's meal-prep vlog. She doesn't write amounts down, so quantities follow the standard version of this dish.
